The updated security review (`pass2`) has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152445-feature-new-pages/security_review.md`.

### Summary of Gate 3 Re-Review
- **Findings:** 0 security findings across the full change and the Gate 3 revisions.
- **`packages/excalidraw/data/blob.ts`:** `Array.isArray(data.appState?.pages) && data.appState.pages.length > 1` safely guards untrusted `pages` input when absent or non-array before `restoreAppState` filters malformed page objects, normalizes viewport fields, and synthesizes a default page if needed.
- **`packages/element/src/Scene.ts`:** `this.sceneNonce = ((this.sceneNonce ?? 0) + 1) | 0` in `setActivePageId` is used strictly for render-cache invalidation.
- **`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` & `packages/excalidraw/components/ConvertElementTypePopup.tsx`:** The three added tests use synthetic element fixtures with no embedded secrets, and `ConvertElementTypePopup.tsx` is cleanly restored to `HEAD`.
